Message.Name: Signon In Message
Message.Description: Logs the user on to the drop copy feed

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password entered by the user; alphabet, numbers and special characters are allowed

Message.Name: Sign On Out Message
Message.Description: Confirms the logon. Alpha Char carries the number of streams the drop copy feed is sent from, one download request being needed per stream. On an error the same transaction code carries the Error Response layout instead, distinguished only by a non zero Error Code

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password entered by the user; alphabet, numbers and special characters are allowed

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Keeps the connection alive, sent only after 30 seconds of inactivity; two missed heartbeats in succession disconnect the socket. Carries the Message Header alone

Message.Name: Dc Download Request Message
Message.Description: Requests the trade download for one stream, named in the first byte of Alpha Char, from the time given in Sequence Number; only trade messages are sent

Field.Name: SequenceNumber
Field.Description: Time the last message was received by the user, taken from Time Stamp1 of the last trade confirmation's Message Header; zero to retrieve from the beginning of the trading day

Message.Name: Dc Order Request Message
Message.Description: Requests the order download for one stream, named in the first byte of Alpha Char, from the time given in Sequence Number; only order messages are sent

Field.Name: SequenceNumber
Field.Description: Time the last message was received by the user, taken from Time Stamp1 of the last order confirmation's Message Header; zero to retrieve from the beginning of the trading day

Message.Name: Dc Ord Trd Request Message
Message.Description: Requests the order and trade download for one stream, named in the first byte of Alpha Char, from the time given in Sequence Number; orders are sent first, then trades, then live messages

Field.Name: SequenceNumber
Field.Description: Time the last message was received by the user, taken from Time Stamp1 of the last order or trade confirmation's Message Header; zero to retrieve from the beginning of the trading day
